subject: Oceanography
title: Marine Protected Areas
description: Learn Marine Protected Areas in one minute.

hook.text: Only 8% of the ocean is in marine protected areas—and less than 3% is fully protected from all extraction.

buildup.text: MPAs restrict harmful activities like fishing and mining—allowing ecosystems to recover and thrive.

discovery.text: Well-enforced no-take zones see fish biomass increase 670% on average—benefits spill over into surrounding waters.

twist.text: Many MPAs are 'paper parks'—protected in name only, with no enforcement or management.

climax.text: The 30×30 target aims to protect 30% of the ocean by 2030—adopted by 196 countries in 2022.

punchline.text: Protected ocean recovers fast—the challenge is protecting enough of it.

quiz.question: How much of the ocean is fully protected from extraction?
